options.description: No notes are read or removed. Any change you want, you make in the Markdown yourself, and the agent builds it with the usual checks, without changing your sentences. Recommended: You asked to modify and regenerate easily and to keep delivery quality, but you did not mention notes or the agent changing your wording. Building what you wrote is what your words support; notes can be added later if you want them.
options.label: Build only what I wrote (Recommended)

options.description: The agent applies each note, removes it, asks you before using any new fact, and only proposes fixes for your own sentences that reviewers raise, without applying them.
options.label: Act on notes inside the file

payload.question:
When you leave a note for the AI inside a release's resume.md or cover-letter.md, should the agent act on it, apply it and remove the note, or should it build only the Markdown exactly as you wrote it?

You said: "I need you to allow my self to modify and regenerate easily the cover letter and resume. We could imagine having in the ouptut release folders the md files that are used to generate the pdfs"
payload.text: Act on notes inside the file
